description: We are a team of enthusiastic students passionate about technology, innovation, science, and problem-solving. With an interest in computer science, AI, and emerging technologies, we are excited to explore real-world challenges and develop creative solutions through the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We welcome teammates who are curious, collaborative, creative, and eager to learn, especially those with skills in programming, AI/ML, data analysis, design, and scientific research.
summary:
ORBITQUEST 3D: BEYOND THE UNKNOWN is an interactive 3D space exploration game prototype designed to make learning about space more engaging through gameplay. Players take the role of an astronaut and explore a space-themed environment using third-person movement and interactive game mechanics.

Our vision is to develop a mission-based experience combining planetary exploration, scientific discovery, and simplified aerospace concepts. The project aims to encourage curiosity about space, introduce players to the challenges of exploration, and make science more accessible through an immersive digital experience.

Developed by Team FAST AND FURIOUS, ORBITQUEST 3D brings together game development, creativity, and educational storytelling. The current prototype establishes the core gameplay foundation, with additional exploration, scientific, and mission features planned for future development.
details: ORBITQUEST 3D: BEYOND THE UNKNOWN is a third-person space exploration game developed to combine interactive entertainment with space-science education. The current prototype includes a main menu, an astronaut character, a training environment, and basic directional movement. The project is designed to grow into a mission-based space adventure featuring planetary environments, scientific discovery, spacecraft concepts, and fictional alien encounters. The game is being developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, and CSS, with Three.js and WebGL for 3D graphics. Visual and gameplay development is carried out using Visual Studio Code. Git and GitHub are used for source-code management and project collaboration. Our creative approach is to introduce space exploration through an interactive astronaut experience rather than relying only on traditional educational content. We aim to encourage curiosity about planetary environments, scientific exploration, and the engineering challenges involved in space missions. The project is an evolving prototype. Additional gameplay, exploration, and educational features are part of our future development roadmap.
